subject: ddl: combine table/partition/db id allocation with job id (#54669)
summary: Reviewed only the DDL-scope changes in this commit vs its parent: CreateSchema/CreateTable no longer pre-allocate IDs; related IDs (schema/table/partition + job) are batched at job insertion via `JobWrapper`/`IDAllocated`. The only plausible Blocker/High was legacy-queue (`DDLForce2Queue`) compatibility (IDs not filled on the legacy enqueue path), but later upstream removes the legacy queue / forces upgrader ownership (e.g. a06f6aacb5, aa83e4e0d5), so no remaining Blocker/High on upstream/master.
